_about: The five corporations, from the World Anvil's Corporations article (roles paraphrased; the article is the authority). Posters are Pulse's concept art (art/pda-v1/imports, manifest 2026-10-30-a): in-world advertising, so their slogans are what the corporation claims, not canon fact. Art use, logos and slogans are pending Nib's review.

corporations.name: Crownline Infrastructure
corporations.role: Utilities, permits, compliance, urban systems, and access to stability.
corporations.about: Runs the power, water, transit-grid support, smart meters, elevators and building certifications. Decides what counts as safe, legal, connected and worth maintaining. Its language avoids describing harm: shutoffs become temporary utility limitations.

campaigns.name: New Halo
campaigns.note: A Crownline initiative: the residential development campaign for New Halo.

corporations.name: Bastion Dynamics
corporations.role: Private security, corporate enforcement, and controlled force.
corporations.about: Adyta's largest security contractor. It doesn't set policy; it's hired to enforce decisions made elsewhere. Crownline writes the notice; Bastion makes it physical. Not the ACW, legally, even when both arrive with shields.

corporations.name: Helix Systems
corporations.role: Cybernetics, biotechnology, experimental medicine, and personal data.
corporations.about: Implants, prosthetics, neural interfaces and treatment you can't get anywhere else, with maintenance, monitoring and licensing attached. Its interest in you doesn't end when your treatment does.

corporations.name: Meridian Logistics
corporations.role: Shipping, freight, transport infrastructure, and supply movement.
corporations.about: Profits from movement, whatever the cargo: relief supplies, eviction equipment, stolen machinery. Often partners with Crownline, but answers to its own contracts.

corporations.name: Velvet Signal
corporations.role: Media, advertising, platform control, reputation management, and narrative suppression.
corporations.about: Sanitizes what the other corporations do. Owns the platforms most of the city reads, watches and works through, Pocket Change included.
corporations.claim: Trust the story that protects you.
